description.value: Housed in a unique 8-sided former Baptist Church built by volunteers in 1910, the Peachland Museum has served the community since 1980 and was declared an official British Columbia Heritage site in 1981. Hundreds of historical artifacts, photographs, newspapers, and documents offer a glimpse into Peachland's pioneer history. The upper floor features a scale model of the Kettle Valley Railway as it existed between 1955 and 1965, which would be of particular interest to cyclists riding the KVR trail.
